package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type practiceLearningActionHTTPStub struct {
	reserve                 domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve
	calls                   int
	err                     error
	opened                  string
	cancelled, cancelReason string
}

type practiceLearningEvidenceHTTPStub struct {
	calls                      int
	studentID, instanceID, key string
	request                    domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2
	err                        error
}

func (stub *practiceLearningEvidenceHTTPStub) Handle(_ context.Context, studentID, instanceID, key string, request domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2) (domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.studentID, stub.instanceID, stub.key, stub.request = studentID, instanceID, key, request
	return domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptV2{Schema: domain.PracticeEvidenceReceiptSchemaV2, EvidenceID: request.EvidenceID, LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, Accepted: true, PolicyVersion: domain.MasteryPolicyVersion}, stub.err
}

func (stub *practiceLearningActionHTTPStub) Reserve(_ context.Context, input domain.PracticeLearningActionReserve) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	stub.calls++
	stub.reserve = input
	return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionHTTPStub) Get(context.Context, string, string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionHTTPStub) Open(_ context.Context, _, _, actionID string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	stub.opened = actionID
	return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, stub.err
}
func (stub *practiceLearningActionHTTPStub) Cancel(_ context.Context, _, _, actionID, reason string) (domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding, error) {
	stub.cancelled, stub.cancelReason = actionID, reason
	return domain.PracticeLearningActionBinding{}, stub.err
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionOpenCancelAreStrictAndOwnerFirst(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, instanceID, actionID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	stub := &practiceLearningActionHTTPStub{err: domain.ErrNotFound}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{PracticeLearningActions: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token", "practice-token")
	base := "/v2/students/" + studentID + "/practice-learning-actions/" + instanceID
	for _, path := range []string{base, "/v2/students/44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444/practice-learning-actions/" + instanceID} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil)
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != http.StatusNotFound {
			t.Fatalf("owner-first path=%s status=%d", path, response.Code)
		}
	}
	openPath := base + "/open"
	badOpen := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, openPath, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-open.v1","learning_action_id":"`+actionID+`","reason":"no"}`))
	badOpen.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	badOpenResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(badOpenResponse, badOpen)
	if badOpenResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.opened != "" {
		t.Fatalf("bad open status=%d opened=%q", badOpenResponse.Code, stub.opened)
	}
	open := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, openPath, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-open.v1","learning_action_id":"`+actionID+`"}`))
	open.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	openResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(openResponse, open)
	if openResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound || stub.opened != actionID {
		t.Fatalf("open status=%d id=%q", openResponse.Code, stub.opened)
	}
	cancelPath := base + "/cancel"
	badCancel := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, cancelPath, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1","learning_action_id":"`+actionID+`","reason":"another_reason"}`))
	badCancel.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	badCancelResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(badCancelResponse, badCancel)
	if badCancelResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.cancelled != "" {
		t.Fatalf("bad cancel status=%d cancelled=%q", badCancelResponse.Code, stub.cancelled)
	}
	cancel := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, cancelPath, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1","learning_action_id":"`+actionID+`","reason":"practice_provisioning_failed"}`))
	cancel.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	cancelResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(cancelResponse, cancel)
	if cancelResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound || stub.cancelled != actionID || stub.cancelReason != domain.PracticeLearningActionCancelReason {
		t.Fatalf("cancel status=%d id=%q reason=%q", cancelResponse.Code, stub.cancelled, stub.cancelReason)
	}
	studentCancel := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, cancelPath, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-cancel.v1","learning_action_id":"`+actionID+`","reason":"student_cancelled"}`))
	studentCancel.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	studentCancelResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(studentCancelResponse, studentCancel)
	if studentCancelResponse.Code != http.StatusNotFound || stub.cancelled != actionID || stub.cancelReason != domain.PracticeLearningActionStudentCancelReason {
		t.Fatalf("student cancellation status=%d id=%q reason=%q", studentCancelResponse.Code, stub.cancelled, stub.cancelReason)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionBodyCap(t *testing.T) {
	stub := &practiceLearningActionHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{PracticeLearningActions: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token", "practice-token")
	request := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, "/v2/students/11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111/practice-learning-actions/22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", strings.NewReader(strings.Repeat("x", practiceLearningActionBodyLimit+1)))
	request.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, request)
	if response.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d", response.Code, stub.calls)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionRoutesRequireDedicatedTokenAndStrictReserveJSON(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, instanceID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"
	stub := &practiceLearningActionHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{PracticeLearningActions: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token", "practice-token")
	path := "/v2/students/" + studentID + "/practice-learning-actions/" + instanceID
	requestedActionID := "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444"
	body := `{"schema":"student-practice-learning-action-reserve.v1","learning_action_id":"` + requestedActionID + `","task_revision_id":"33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333","task_revision_digest":"sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","surface_classification":"practice","learning_targets":[{"type":"concept","key":"go.interfaces","version":"v1"}]}`
	for _, token := range []string{"", "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", instanceID)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden || stub.calls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d calls=%d", token, response.Code, stub.calls)
		}
	}
	unknown := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(strings.TrimSuffix(body, "}")+`,"private_fixture":"no"}`))
	unknown.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	unknown.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", instanceID)
	unknownResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unknownResponse, unknown)
	if unknownResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unknown status=%d calls=%d", unknownResponse.Code, stub.calls)
	}
	trailing := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, strings.NewReader(body+" {}"))
	trailing.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	trailing.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", instanceID)
	trailingResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(trailingResponse, trailing)
	if trailingResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("trailing status=%d calls=%d", trailingResponse.Code, stub.calls)
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPut, path, bytes.NewBufferString(body))
	req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", instanceID)
	response := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
	if response.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.calls != 1 || stub.reserve.StudentID != studentID || stub.reserve.TaskInstanceID != instanceID || stub.reserve.IdempotencyKey != instanceID || stub.reserve.LearningActionID != requestedActionID {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d reserve=%+v", response.Code, stub.calls, stub.reserve)
	}
}

func TestPracticeLearningActionEvidenceV2RequiresDedicatedTokenAndStrictBody(t *testing.T) {
	studentID, instanceID := "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333"
	stub := &practiceLearningEvidenceHTTPStub{}
	router := NewRouter(&Handler{PracticeLearningEvidence: stub}, "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token", "practice-token")
	request := domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceBundleV2{Schema: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidenceSchemaV2,
		EvidenceID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", LearningActionID: "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
		StudentID: studentID, TaskInstanceID: instanceID, TaskRevisionID: "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
		TaskRevisionDigest: "sha256:aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa", WorkspaceDigest: "sha256:bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb",
		SubmissionID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", Outcome: "passed", AssistancePolicyVersion: "practice-assistance-v1",
		Evidence:   []domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidence{{Target: domain.LearningTargetRef{Type: domain.LearningTargetCapability, Key: "go.errors.wrap", Version: "v1"}, Correctness: 1, Independence: 1, Confidence: 1, StepIDs: []string{"implement"}}},
		OccurredAt: time.Now().UTC(), PolicyVersion: domain.PracticeCompetencyEvidencePolicyV2}
	body, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	path := "/v2/students/" + studentID + "/practice-learning-actions/" + instanceID + "/evidence"
	for _, token := range []string{"", "general-token", "planner-token", "teacher-token"} {
		req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
		req.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", token)
		req.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", request.EvidenceID)
		response := httptest.NewRecorder()
		router.ServeHTTP(response, req)
		if response.Code != http.StatusForbidden || stub.calls != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("token=%q status=%d calls=%d", token, response.Code, stub.calls)
		}
	}
	unknown := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(strings.TrimSuffix(string(body), "}")+`,"raw_validation":"forbidden"}`))
	unknown.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	unknown.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", request.EvidenceID)
	unknownResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(unknownResponse, unknown)
	if unknownResponse.Code != http.StatusBadRequest || stub.calls != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("unknown status=%d calls=%d", unknownResponse.Code, stub.calls)
	}
	valid := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodPost, path, bytes.NewReader(body))
	valid.Header.Set("X-Internal-Token", "practice-token")
	valid.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", request.EvidenceID)
	validResponse := httptest.NewRecorder()
	router.ServeHTTP(validResponse, valid)
	if validResponse.Code != http.StatusOK || stub.calls != 1 || stub.studentID != studentID || stub.instanceID != instanceID || stub.key != request.EvidenceID || stub.request.LearningActionID != request.LearningActionID {
		t.Fatalf("status=%d calls=%d stub=%+v", validResponse.Code, stub.calls, stub)
	}
}
